Ordering overnight? Your order goes out the same day, within of our opening.

div.p: Every order is packed in a sealed, insulated box to keep it chilled all the way to you, and many cuts are vacuum-sealed for freshness.

It’s best to have someone there to receive your order. If no one is available, the order is left at your door and should be taken in as soon as possible to keep it chilled. Once it’s left at the door, keeping it safe is your responsibility.
Someone else receiving it? Add their name and mobile number in the order note before you pay.

div.style: max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px 40px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 48px

div.p: Call or WhatsApp us on before your order leaves for delivery, and we’ll cancel it. Contact us before your order leaves for delivery, and we’ll cancel it. Once it’s on its way, it can’t be cancelled.

Tell us as soon as you receive your order. If we sent the wrong item, we’ll collect it and deliver the right one at no cost to you, as long as it’s unopened and has been kept chilled. See our Terms of Sale.
If the box arrives damaged, please tell us when you receive it.
